The '''''Nu''-class attack shuttle''', also known as the '''Republic attack shuttle''', was a vessel used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
The ''Nu''-class was a faster, long-range supplementary design to the standard [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] line, and shared similar design characteristics to the [[NR2 gully jumper]] of the [[Great Galactic War]]. The class had heavier [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]] than most atmospheric craft. It was equipped with a hyperdrive, allowing it to operate a long distance away from bases and motherships, which the hyperdriveless [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT/i]] simply could not. Nu-class also had seats for the passengers due to it being designed for long distance travel, which the LAAT/i did not have due to being mostly used for atmospheric flights not too far away from a base and quick flights between surface and the mothership.

[[File:Nu-classShuttleLanded-TCW.png|thumb|left|250px|A ''Nu''-class shuttle in landing configuration]]
However, the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] remained very competitive with the ''Nu'': while the shuttle could only carry 30 [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]], the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] could carry that ''and'' four [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] in addition, though doing so made the LAAT quite cramped. The shuttle also lacked the [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]] of the LAAT/i and was in general much inferior in a gunship role. Lack of a hyperdrive also made the LAAT/i much cheaper to produce. As a result, it wasn't a complete replacement for the affectionately nicknamed "larty" which was a significantly more common sight in the hangars of [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Acclamator-class assault ships]] and [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="TCWCG" />

It was designed with fold-down wings, similar to [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] like the [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent]] and later shuttle designs like the [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle/Legends|''Theta''-class]] and [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class]]. Its boarding hatch was located at the front of the shuttle, in what could be described as the vessel's "chin". The [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]' chairs would lower them into the boarding area for them to leave the ship, and visa-versa.<ref name="SW:TCWf">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

It would also appear to have been equipped with some form of [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] or magnetic [[Docking clamp/Legends|clamp]]; as used to carry [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] after he had crashed the [[Defender/Legends|''Defender'']] into the command ship of the Separatist blockade over the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref>

==History==
===Republic use===
[[File:RishiStationLandingPad-CN.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Obex/Legends|''Obex'']] docked at [[Rishi Station/Legends|Rishi Station]]]]
A shuttle of this kind delivered [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] during a heavy [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|battle]] there.<ref name="SW:TCWf" />
[[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] flew the ''Nu''-class shuttle [[Obex/Legends|''Obex'']] as a transport while conducting an inspection tour of [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic]] outposts staffed with rookie troops. When they landed at the [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] on the [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] [[Rishi moon|moon]], their shuttle was destroyed by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commandos]].

Another ''Nu''-class shuttle delivered [[Nahdar Vebb/Legends|Nahdar Vebb]] and a small squad of clone troopers to [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|the third moon]] of [[Vassek/Legends|Vassek]] during the [[Mission to Grievous's castle/Legends|mission]] to recapture [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]. After stumbling into [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] castle, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] ordered the clones to call in for reinforcements using the shuttle's transceiver, but it was destroyed by [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|MagnaGuards]].

A ''Nu''-class shuttle was used on a diplomatic mission by Commander [[Stone (clone trooper)/Legends|CC-5869]], his troops, [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Kharrus/Legends|Kharrus]], who were en route to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] to the Weequay pirates' lair with a bounty of spice on board as a ransom for [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. While entering Florrum's atmosphere, they were shot down by the pirates. Kharrus died in the crash along with the two pilots. The shuttle was unable to take off again because it was broken in two.

A ''Nu''-class shuttle was used to transport [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] escape pod after he destroyed the leading ship blockading [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] with the [[Defender/Legends|''Defender'']].<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />

[[File:DSquadCargoShuttle-PoNR.png|thumb|right|250px|A larger ''Nu''-class shuttle used by D-Squad during the Carida incident.]]
As the Clone Wars progressed, a larger variant with a massive underslung cargo bay, entered service with the Republic. One such shuttle was captured by the Confederacy on [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]], and was used to load a Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class cruiser]] with [[Rhydonium/Legends|rhydonium]] to blow up a Republic space station in the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida system]]. However, the shuttle was captured by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregor/Legends|Gregor]] and [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]].<ref name="Missing In Action">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref>

Another modified ''Nu''-class shuttle was used to transport [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Tup/Legends|Tup]] from [[Ringo Vinda/Legends|Ringo Vinda]] to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. However, it was rendered inoperable before it could even leave Ringo Vinda due to a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle of Ringo Vinda/Legends|assault]]. The shuttles dorsal wing was adorned with the symbol of the clone medic corps.<ref name="The Unknown">{{TCW|The Unknown}}</ref>

===Later use===
[[File:NuClassAttackShuttle-SWE.png|thumb|left|250px|''Nu''-class attack shuttles continued to be used into the Imperial era.]]
The ''Nu''-class shuttle was later used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="DT22" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="3 ABY">''[[Drone Alone]]'' is set just after the [[Occupation of Bespin]], which is noted to occur in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had one attack shuttle. It was used by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker's]] [[Raptor Squad]] on a [[mission to steal hyperdrive components]].<ref name="Drone Alone" />

At least one escort shuttle fell into the hands of the Imperial splinter faction known as the [[Restored Empire|"hard-liners"]] stationed on the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[RZ7-6113-23]]. The shuttle was stolen by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kir Kanos]] during his escape from the hard-liners' ship storehouse.<ref name="CE3.4" />
